title: Croatian Pasta with a Zesty Twist
description: A unique fusion of Indian and Croatian flavors in this zesty pasta dish, perfect for a quick weeknight meal.

ingredients.name: Croatian pasta
ingredients.notes: Choose a robust pasta shape like penne or rigatoni

ingredients.name: Zesty tomato sauce
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought, whichever suits your taste

ingredients.name: Cumin
ingredients.notes: Add a warm Indian touch to the dish

ingredients.name: Garam masala
ingredients.notes: Another Indian spice blend to enhance the flavors

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Freshly ground for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: For sautéing the onions and spices

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the Croatian pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the spring onions until they start to soften.
Add the cumin and garam masala to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the zesty tomato sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and garnish with chopped fresh cilantro.
Optional: Add some diced chicken or shrimp to the pasta for added protein.
